releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.18
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.18**: 2 changes since 0.1.17.

- Ask before closing a terminal an agent runs in (#2323)
- Track Rune dev 01349dbf: snap sheet separators to device pixels, preserve pending input in runtime-managed fields on inactivity, and pick up upstream text, font fallback and rendering fixes (#2292). Native UIKit's stale-owner composition cancellation is unchanged.
